blogs.title: Meet Direct Preference Optimization: Simplifying RLHF for Everyone
blogs.description: An accessible introduction to DPO, explaining why most modern LLM alignment workflows rely on complex RLHF pipelines—and how DPO collapses reward modeling and policy optimization into one simple cross-entropy loss. Ideal for ML enthusiasts looking to understand the latest in AI alignment research.

blogs.title: How Your Language Model Acts as Its Own Reward Model
blogs.description: A deep-dive into the reparameterization trick behind DPO: showing how we can view a fine-tuned language model’s probability ratios as an implicit reward function. We'll cover the math at a high level, visual illustrations, and intuitive examples.

blogs.title: DPO vs. PPO-Based RLHF: A Practical Comparison
blogs.description: An empirical and conceptual comparison of Direct Preference Optimization and traditional PPO-based RLHF. We’ll walk through the reward-KL frontier, discuss hyperparameter tuning, runtime costs, and show when you might prefer one method over the other in real-world projects.

blogs.title: Hands-On Tutorial: Controlling Sentiment Generation with DPO
blogs.description: Step by step guide to implementing DPO for sentiment steering. Starting from a pre-trained GPT-2, you’ll learn how to gather or simulate preference pairs, set up the DPO loss in PyTorch (or JAX), and evaluate your model’s sentiment control and KL divergence.

blogs.title: Scaling DPO to Large Models: Lessons and Best Practices
blogs.description: Practical advice for applying Direct Preference Optimization to multi-billion-parameter models. We cover data reuse (leveraging existing preference datasets), efficient GPU memory strategies, checkpointing, and tips for choosing the β “conservativeness” hyperparameter at scale.

blogs.title: Beyond Text: Can DPO Train Image and Audio Generators from Preferences?
blogs.description: A forward-looking exploration of adapting DPO to other generative tasks—like image synthesis or music generation. We’ll discuss necessary changes to the preference collection process, model architectures, and potential challenges in non-text domains.

blogs.title: Inside the Theory: Why DPO Guarantees the Optimal Policy
blogs.description: A blog for students and researchers delving into the theoretical foundations of Direct Preference Optimization. We unpack the equivalence class of reward functions under the Bradley-Terry model, prove why DPO recovers the optimal policy in closed form, and compare it to actor-critic instability in PPO.
